description: This Java class 'ReadJsonArrayHeadersFilter' extends 'AbstractHeaderEntryFilter' and is responsible for filtering header entries that are of 'JsonArray' serialization type. It interprets header values either as actual JSON arrays or as comma-separated strings and converts them into JSON arrays. It is used within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically for processing headers in protocol messages.

classes.name: ReadJsonArrayHeadersFilter
classes.description: Final class that filters header entries by interpreting certain headers as JSON arrays or comma-separated lists, providing an easy way to process headers with JsonArray serialization type.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory method returning an instance of ReadJsonArrayHeadersFilter configured with given header definitions.

methods.name: filterValue
methods.description: Overrides a protected method to filter header values, converting JSON array headers into their string representation.

methods.name: isJsonArrayDefinition
methods.description: Checks if a header key corresponds to a header definition that serializes as a JsonArray.

methods.name: getJsonArray
methods.description: Parses a header value into a JsonArray, or returns an empty JsonArray if the input is empty.

methods.name: tryToParseJsonArray
methods.description: Attempts to parse a string as a JsonArray; if parsing fails, treats the string as a comma-separated list and converts it into a JsonArray.
